questions.question: What is the key characteristic that defines zero-party data collected through an in-app message survey?
options: It is information the user intentionally shares with the brand
It is inferred by machine learning based on web browsing history
It is aggregated data purchased from a third-party
It is collected passively from transactional events
questions.explanation: Zero-party data is information users intentionally share through surveys, making it the most valuable and accurate customer data.

questions.question: Which two Braze features must be utilized to dynamically pull product images, names, and prices into a personalized message for a back-in-stock notification?
questions.explanation: Braze Catalogs store product data and Liquid is used to dynamically reference and display that data in messages.
